_comment: ERAN v2 - learns from RAW SOUND (his .wav voice), not text. The neural audio codec (EnCodec) is the artificial cochlea; a from-zero transformer learns to predict the next AUDIO token and babbles in sound.
_model_note: BIGGER brain (Iddo: 'go bigger, use real GPU'). ~25M params vs 3M. Kept mic-safe: vram_cap 1800MB leaves the Hebrew mic its ~5.6GB on the 8GB card. To use the full ~7GB Eran wants, the mic must pause OR move to the ADA 6000.
